title: [Salty's Services, Signs]
description: Preconstructed signs made from various woods are densely stacked across the area, as if the entire storage operation for them is contained within the room.  Signs and sign-making materials are placed precariously to the height of several giantkin wall-to-wall.  Flecks of paint aggressively splatter the floor and also the ceiling, like whoever made these signs was set in a pitched battle against them.  A dark iron brazier, also speckled with paint, hangs from the ceiling and dimly lights the area.
